description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage team building AI-powered software for supply chain connectivity. You will help create purpose-built coding agents and the infrastructure that runs mission-critical integrations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build AI coding agents for supply chain integrations.

 - Develop and maintain the core infrastructure for hosting and running integrations.

 - Own systems end-to-end, from the agent platform to the integrations runtime, and make foundational architectural decisions.

 - Establish engineering patterns and practices as the team and product grow.

 - Work across both agentic AI features and complex infrastructure.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Two to five years of hands-on experience as a full-stack or backend engineer, with a track record of shipping and owning software end-to-end.

 - Proficiency in TypeScript and modern full-stack development; experience with React, Bun, Effect-TS, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, or AWS is relevant.

 - Practical experience building with AI agents or LLMs using current approaches.

 - Strong autonomy and experience building products or systems from scratch, ideally in a high-growth startup environment.

 - Strong computer science or engineering fundamentals, through a degree or equivalent experience.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Annual salary: $150,000 to $300,000 USD. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, United States.
